description: Fix critical TypeScript compilation errors and rate limiting API signature mismatch blocking the build. 22 TypeScript errors found blocking npm run typecheck.
steps: Fix lib/rate-limit.ts signature: Change rateLimit(token, limit, window) to match actual usage rateLimit(options?) returning { check(limit, token) }. The function currently returns { check(limit, token) } but is called with 3 positional args in app/actions/auth.ts lines 25-27, 44.

Update app/actions/auth.ts lines 25-27 and 44 to use new signature: const limiter = rateLimit({ interval: 600000, uniqueTokenPerInterval: 500 }); const result = limiter.check(30, `login:ip:${ip}`); if (!result.success) return error.
Fix tests/phases-9-12.test.ts lines 9, 185-190: Remove resetRateLimits import (does not exist), update rateLimit calls to use new API.
Fix tests/scope.test.ts lines 41-42: Change readonly array types to mutable in test fixtures: const scope: DataScope = { kind: 'TEAMS', userId: 'u1', teamIds: ['t1'] } (remove readonly from array).
Fix lib/env.ts line 134: Change comparison from env.TELEPHONY_PROVIDER !== '' to check for actual provider value or remove dead code comparing literal '"exotel"' to '""'.
Fix prisma/seed-demo.ts line 86: Ensure teamId is never null when creating demo users with teams, add type assertion or filter.
Run npm run typecheck to verify all 22 TypeScript errors are resolved.
